body:
UI design rulings not written elsewhere.

Transcript follow (Greg's design ruling, 2026-09-03, epic tm-7cu): one scroll state per pane, FOLLOW or STAY. FOLLOW keeps the bottom in view on every transcript growth (messages, command and delegation cards, streamed text, the live-turn card), uniformly. STAY never moves on content changes; growth is signalled by New response only. Only user gestures change the state: scrolling up gives STAY; reaching the bottom, End, clicking New response or sending a prompt gives FOLLOW. Content changes, resize, viewport clamps, hydration, reconnect and tab switches never change it. The state is per workspace tab, persists across switches and is never re-derived from geometry. There is no exception for approvals or user input: signal, do not scroll. Resolve scroll bugs against this spec; do not patch them one by one. The current mechanics are in docs/features/session-virtualized-transcript.md.

Theme token: --surface-white (and its strong and soft variants) is a translucent highlight wash, especially in dark themes. It is not a base surface, despite its name. Never feed it to canvas-rendered or portaled opaque surfaces such as Monaco editor and minimap backgrounds. Use a base token such as --panel-strong, and force alpha 1 where the consumer cannot rely on DOM compositing.
